risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on, changing channels, adjusting volume, and displaying different content types (e.g., live TV, streaming, HDMI input) for at least 30 seconds.

risks.risk: The TV is not the advertised model (e.g., a different model or refurbished unit with misleading overlay)
risks.proof: A photo of the TV's back panel showing the model number label, or a photo of the TV's settings menu showing the exact model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lower-tier model or non-genuine

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., scratches, dents, or cracked stand)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the TV's bezel, frame, and stand from all angles, including the back and sides.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a discount for potential hidden damage
